contents.reason: The golden rule needs a continuum density of states and a long-time limit; the driven pair proves finite-time amplitudes with explicit remainders only, and radiative rates belong to the light-matter pair.

contents.reason: Radiative rates and emitted-photon statements require the quantized radiation modes of the light-matter pair; this pair asserts no rate, lifetime or photon.

Section 1 pp. 1-9: the harmonic oscillator spectrum and its normalizable states
contents.reason: The oscillator model is built and owned by the harmonic-oscillator pair; this driven-dynamics pair consumes that model without re-deriving its spectrum or completeness.

contents.reason: Squeezed states are not part of the declared driven models of this pair and no statement of the pair uses them.
